blurb: Stone River Golf Club features an 18-hole par 72 course with Bermuda grass greens, fairways, and tees. The course measures 6,432 yards from the Blue Tees, 5,873 yards from the White Tees, and 5,014 yards from the Red Tees. Facilities include a putting green, practice range, clubhouse, pro shop, and grill.
extraNote: Tee times preferred but walk-ups allowed; tee times may be made up to 7 days in advance · Cart fees reduced during greens renovation project · Front nine greens under renovation with temporary greens; back nine greens open with repairs
